## Goal and context
Domain/stage, protected creative goal, skill version, host/model:

## Reproduction
Minimal prompt/material and steps. State whether material is original, fictional or shared with permission. Remove private data.

## Actual result
Relevant excerpt or tool error; say what the assistant could actually access:

## Expected behavior and reason
Which decision did this fail to help? What would a useful response preserve or change?

## Severity
Ordinary usability issue / misleading evidence or observation / privacy or authorization issue. Do not put sensitive security details in this public form.
